name: visual-expert
description: List, explain, fix and triage Visual Expert Code Inspection findings (defects) from Claude Code.

base_url.title: Visual Expert URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your Visual Expert web server, e.g. https://visualexpert.mycompany.local or https://demo.visual-expert.com

auth.title: Sign-in method
auth.description: windows = your Windows logon (no password stored); form = email + password; cookie = paste a browser Cookie header

email.title: Email (form sign-in)
email.description: Visual Expert login email. Leave empty for Windows sign-in.

password.title: Password (form sign-in)
password.description: Visual Expert password. Stored in your OS credential store. Leave empty for Windows sign-in.

cookie.title: Cookie header (cookie sign-in)
cookie.description: Only for cookie sign-in: the Cookie request header copied from a signed-in browser.

project.title: Default project
project.description: Optional. Project name or id (the number after /codeinspection/ in the URL). You can also pick one in chat.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.description: 'latest' follows the newest analysis automatically. Enter an analysis id only to pin an older one.

verify_tls.title: Verify TLS certificate
verify_tls.description: Turn off only for an on-prem server with a self-signed certificate.
